name: Muamalat Banking PoC - Hermes local coding evaluation
author: Bayuzen Ahmad
classification: Public synthetic demonstration; no bank endorsement or real customer data
purpose: Evaluate a local AI coding assistant against independent acceptance tests using a bank website as the workload.

features.name: Synthetic onboarding and login
features.description: Demo-prefixed names and example.test email addresses only; password hashing; opaque HttpOnly session; server-side revocation.

features.name: Account dashboard
features.description: Authenticated account ownership filter, masked account display, integer rupiah balance and session restoration.

features.name: Simulated transfers
features.description: Two synthetic recipients; confirmation; idempotency; transaction and row lock; insufficient-funds and cross-user denial.

features.name: Privacy controls
features.description: Independent AES-GCM and HMAC keys; masking; explicit marketing preference; reauthenticated profile export; erasure request recorded pending verification and retention review.

features.name: Local AI GitHub review
features.description: Fetch a PR patch, review with installed Ollama model on literal loopback, recheck head SHA; advisory JSON findings. Never auto-merge.

features.name: DevOps quality and release documentation
features.description: Dependency audit, browser acceptance, backend coverage, Sonar task-specific quality gate, non-root image and immutable artifact evidence; documentation follows successful gates.
